source.note: Header matches the vendor's public protocol document. A second read is still due.

silences.action: Leave the unit idle with both ports open.
silences.result: No clock, no active sensing and no other message.

silences.action: Press the virtual keyboard buttons in NOTE mode.
silences.note: The track outputs may not route to USB. The full key sequence was not logged.

silences.action: Press PLAY/STOP (B68) to start, then to stop.
silences.result: Nothing on either port. B68 was solid red while the sequencer ran.
silences.note: In USB operation mode the unit has no internal clock, so a clock is not expected.

silences.action: Turn encoder 1 once and press button 1 once, before the routing was read.
silences.note: Later runs (H3) did send controller changes, so the first silence is not explained.

silences.action: Press B21, B22, B23 and B24 once each, in presets 1 and 4.
silences.result: Nothing on any port, in four runs.
silences.note: The stored presets give these buttons no assignment in preset 4. They may switch the preset on the unit. That is unproven.

source.note: Runs 2, 3a and 3c of the guided map on 2026-11-12. Run 3c listened to all ports.

silences.action: Press B65, B66, B67 and B68 once each.
silences.result: Nothing on any port, in four runs.
silences.note: The stored preset 4 gives these buttons no assignment.

source.note: Runs 2, 3a and 3c of the guided map on 2026-11-12. Run 3c listened to all ports.

silences.action: Turn E30, E31 and E38 (knobs printed 6, 7 and 14) both ways.

silences.note: Preset 4 has no assignment for encoders 6, 7 and 14. The backup export confirms this.

source.note: Runs 2, 3a and 3c of the guided map on 2026-11-12. Run 3c listened to all ports.

silences.action: Push each knob E25 to E56 once, without turning it.
silences.result: 28 of 32 pushes sent nothing. Four pushes sent a message that is not explained.
silences.note: E36 sent F0 7F 7F 06 02 F7 (a MIDI Machine Control play message). E25, E26 and E42 sent controller changes that match other controls. A repeat run is open.

source.note: Runs 2, 3a and 3c of the guided map on 2026-11-12. Run 3c listened to all ports.

silences.action: Send the identity request F0 7E 7F 06 01 F7 to the CTRL port.
silences.result: No reply and no change on the unit.
silences.note: Inbound test (step 4.4). Sent with unit-send; a listener ran on all ports. A new sequencer export afterwards matched the first export.

silences.action: Send the identity request F0 7E 7F 06 01 F7 to the ZAQ port.
silences.result: No reply and no change on the unit.
silences.note: Inbound test (step 4.4). Sent with unit-send; a listener ran on all ports. A new sequencer export afterwards matched the first export.

silences.action: Send start (FA), then 3 seconds later stop (FC), to the ZAQ port.
silences.result: No reply. PLAY/STOP did not light. The unit stayed with the internal clock source.
silences.note: Inbound test (step 4.4). Sent with unit-send; a listener ran on all ports. A new sequencer export afterwards matched the first export.

silences.action: Send note on (channel 1, note 60, velocity 100), then note off, to the ZAQ port.
silences.result: No reply and no change. Transpose was Off.
silences.note: Inbound test (step 4.4). Sent with unit-send; a listener ran on all ports. A new sequencer export afterwards matched the first export.

silences.action: Send controller change 1 value 64, then program change 2, on channel 1 to the ZAQ port.
silences.result: No reply. The pattern did not change. Pattern change channel (B13) was Off.
